keeper_covenant.name: The Keeper's Covenant
keeper_covenant.summary: Use remembered evidence to amend the prison covenant, making the Hearth a mortal guarantor between gods, prisoners, and nations.

mortal_compact.name: The Mortal Compact
mortal_compact.summary: Unite rival nations around shared stewardship and deny every pantheon sole ownership of the prisons.

divine_concord.name: The Divine Concord
divine_concord.summary: Broker enforceable limits among rival gods, paid for through promises the Keeper has proven can be kept.

broken_thrones.name: The Broken Thrones
broken_thrones.summary: Expose the incomplete divine history and sever the old prison system before gods or nations can rebuild it unchanged.
